meta.title: ARUVI — A gentler place for difficult days
meta.description: A free, private and multilingual wellness space for people living with migraine, depression, anxiety and stress.

i18n.partial: {language} is being translated. Until it's ready, some text is shown in English.

hero.title: A gentler place for difficult days.
hero.body: A safe, quiet space to notice how you feel, slow down, and care for yourself — without pressure or judgement.

mood.title: How are you feeling right now?
mood.subtitle: There's no right answer. Choose whatever feels closest — it's okay if it changes.
mood.privacy: In this preview, nothing leaves your device.

responses.happy: It's lovely that today feels lighter. You might like to note what helped, so you can return to it.
responses.calm: A calm moment is worth noticing. Stay with it for as long as you like.
responses.sad: Sadness can feel heavy. You don't have to fix it right now — being gentle with yourself is enough.
responses.anxious: Anxiety can make everything feel urgent. A slow breath out can help your body feel a little safer.
responses.overwhelmed: When everything feels like too much, it's okay to pick just one small thing — or nothing at all.
responses.irritated: Irritation often means something matters to you. A short pause may give you some space.
responses.exhausted: Being this tired is real. Rest is not something you have to earn.
responses.lonely: Loneliness is hard. If you can, reaching out to one person you trust may help — even with a short message.
responses.numb: Feeling numb is a way minds sometimes protect themselves. You're still here, and that matters.

calm.title: My Calm Space
calm.subtitle: A quiet place to slow your breathing. Pause, change or stop whenever you like.
calm.rounds: {count, plural, =0 {No rounds yet} one {# round completed} other {# rounds completed}}
calm.note: No flashing or fast movement. Sounds stay off unless you choose to turn them on.

features.title: Everything moves at your pace
features.subtitle: Use what helps, skip what doesn't. Nothing here is a task you have to finish.

calm.title: Calm Space
calm.body: Breathing, grounding and body relaxation with quiet nature scenes.

journal.title: Mood & Emotion Journal
journal.body: Notice your feelings, write freely, and see gentle patterns over time.

companion.title: AI Wellness Companion
companion.body: A supportive listener in your language. Not a doctor or therapist.

migraine.title: Migraine Diary
migraine.body: Record episodes, symptoms and possible triggers, and export a report for your doctor.

sleep.title: Sleep & Energy
sleep.body: Track rest, sleep quality and energy to understand your days.

insights.title: Wellness Insights
insights.body: Simple, descriptive overviews of your own records — never a diagnosis.

free.title: Free for everyone
free.body: No subscriptions and no paid features.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Your journals and conversations are yours. We never sell personal or health information.

gentle.title: No pressure
gentle.body: No streaks, no guilt. Come back whenever you need to.

notMedical.title: Support, not treatment
notMedical.body: ARUVI does not replace professional medical or psychological care.

help.title: If you need help right now
help.body: If you are in danger or thinking about harming yourself, please reach out to a person now. You deserve support.

lines.national: National Mental Health Helpline (Sri Lanka, 24 hours)

help.note: ARUVI is not an emergency service. If you might act on thoughts of harming yourself, please contact one of these services or go to the nearest hospital.
help.noList: We don’t have a verified helpline list for this country yet. Please call your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital. You can also find a free, confidential crisis line near you here:
help.findMore: Find a helpline in your country

footer.tagline: A gentler place for difficult days.
footer.disclaimer: ARUVI is a supportive wellness companion. It is not a replacement for professional medical or psychological treatment.
footer.made: Made with care. Free for everyone.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to see your journal, diaries and insights.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Free, private and yours. You can delete everything at any time.
auth.name: What should we call you?
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
auth.acceptTerms: I agree to the terms and privacy policy.
auth.acceptHealth: I consent to ARUVI storing the wellbeing information I choose to enter (moods, journals, migraine and sleep records), privately and only for me.
auth.tryWithout: Or try a breathing exercise without an account

errors.invalid: That email and password don't match. Please try again.
errors.exists: We couldn't sign you in. If you already have an account, please sign in instead.
errors.checkFields: Please check the fields and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

overview.subtitle: How are you arriving today? There's nothing you have to do here.
overview.subtitleCheckedIn: Thank you for checking in today. Take whatever you need.
overview.verified: Your email is confirmed. Thank you.
overview.verifyFailed: That confirmation link didn't work or has expired.
overview.verifyPending: We've sent you a link to confirm your email. You can keep using ARUVI in the meantime.
overview.calmBody: A few slow breaths, whenever you need them.
overview.companionBody: A gentle listener, in your language.

suggestions.0: Drink a glass of water, slowly.
suggestions.1: Step outside or open a window for a minute of fresh air.
suggestions.2: Loosen your shoulders and let your jaw soften.
suggestions.3: Send a short message to someone you trust.
suggestions.4: Rest your eyes away from screens for five minutes.
suggestions.5: Notice one small thing that went okay today.

overview.noJournal: No entries yet. Writing even one line can help.

journal.title: Mood & journal
journal.subtitle: Notice how you feel and write freely. Only you can see this.

prompts.0: What is one thing that felt heavy today, and one thing that felt a little lighter?
prompts.1: What does your body need right now?
prompts.2: Describe a place where you feel safe.
prompts.3: What would you say to a friend who felt the way you do today?
prompts.4: What is something small you're grateful for?
prompts.5: What drained your energy today? What gave you some back?
prompts.6: If your feelings had a weather, what would it be?
prompts.7: What is one kind thing you could do for yourself tomorrow?

migraine.title: Migraine diary
migraine.subtitle: Keep a simple headache diary you can share with your doctor.
migraine.disclaimer: This diary records what you notice. Patterns shown here are not a medical diagnosis. Please talk to a doctor about your headaches and any medication.
migraine.intensityHint: 0 means no pain, 10 means the worst pain you can imagine.
migraine.triggersHint: Only what you noticed yourself. These are possibilities, not causes.
migraine.medicationHint: Your own record only. ARUVI never suggests medication.

report.title: Headache diary report
report.disclaimer: This report contains information recorded by the person themselves in ARUVI. It is not a diagnosis. Possible triggers are self-reported observations.

sleep.title: Sleep & energy
sleep.subtitle: A quick daily note about rest and energy helps you understand your days.
sleep.dateHint: Record last night's sleep on today's date.

insights.title: Wellness insights
insights.subtitle: A simple look back at what you've recorded.
insights.disclaimer: These are descriptions of your own records, not medical conclusions. Something appearing together does not mean one causes the other.
insights.notEnough: Keep recording for a little while and gentle observations will appear here.

obs.topTrigger: You noted "{trigger}" as a possible trigger in {count} of {total} episodes.
obs.lowSleepMigraine: On {share}% of the days you recorded a migraine, you had also recorded less than 6 hours of sleep, compared with {overall}% of all nights you recorded.
obs.steadyMood: The feeling you checked in with most often was "{mood}" ({count} times).

settings.title: Settings

trackMenstrual.title: Include menstrual cycle as a possible trigger
trackMenstrual.body: Optional. Only shown in your migraine diary.

keepAiHistory.title: Keep companion conversation history
keepAiHistory.body: Off by default. When on, your conversations are saved so you can return to them. You can delete them at any time.

settings.comfortNote: Theme, text size and language are on the top bar and are remembered on this device.
settings.exportBody: Get a copy of everything ARUVI stores about you, as a JSON file.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account and everything in it: moods, journals, diaries and conversations. This can't be undone.

companion.title: Companion
companion.subtitle: Share what's on your mind. Write in any language you like.
companion.disclaimer: The companion is an AI, not a therapist or doctor. It can make mistakes and cannot diagnose or give medical advice. If you are in danger, please use the numbers in “Get help” or call your local emergency number.
companion.emptyBody: How are you feeling right now?
companion.historyOn: Conversations are saved. You can turn this off in Settings.
companion.historyOff: Conversations aren't saved. They disappear when you leave this page.
companion.crisisTitle: You don't have to go through this alone
companion.crisisBody: It sounds like things are really hard right now. Please reach out to a person who can help — you can call now, any time of day.

errors.refusal: I’m not able to respond to that. If you’re struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or use the numbers in “Get help”.
errors.unavailable: The companion isn't available right now. Please try again later.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: You seem to be offline. Please check your connection.
errors.limit: You've sent a lot of messages for now. Please take a short break and try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mobile.guestBody: Create a free account to keep your records private and safe across devices.
mobile.offline: Can’t reach ARUVI right now. Please check your connection and try again.
mobile.reportOnWeb: The printable doctor report is available on the ARUVI website.
